metadata.description: Parent or teacher rating scale for ADHD and oppositional-defiant symptoms.
metadata.intended_use: Research and multi-informant screening of childhood attention, hyperactivity, and oppositional symptoms.
metadata.name_origin: SNAP refers to Swanson, Nolan, and Pelham; IV reflects the diagnostic symptom framework used in the scale.
metadata.development_history: Developed for rating ADHD and oppositional symptoms in children and adolescents.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Separate symptom domains support comparison across informants and settings.
metadata.interpretation_notes: German wording, scoring, norms, and permissions must be verified for the selected form; ratings are not a diagnosis.
